mapper.select: select comment.*, user.username from comment join user on user.id = comment.user_id where topic_id = #{topicid} order by create_time desc
select c.*, u.username as author_name,u.avatar as user_avatar from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.topic_id = #{topicId} and c.level = 1 order by c.create_time desc

select c.*, u.username as author_name,u.avatar as user_avatar, ru.username as reply_to_username from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id # 创建用户 left join user ru on c.reply_to_user_id = ru.id # 被回复的用户 where c.root_id = #{rootId} and c.level = 2 # 二级评论 order by c.create_time
